Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions about our RO services? Find answers to the most common queries about RO repair, maintenance, pricing, and service policies. Can't find what you're looking for? Just give us a call!

How long does a typical RO service take?

A standard RO service usually takes 45-60 minutes, depending on the type of service required. Basic cleaning and filter checks take about 30-45 minutes, while comprehensive servicing with part replacements may take up to 90 minutes.

What warranty do you provide on repairs and services?

We provide a 30-day warranty on all repairs and a standard manufacturer warranty on all genuine spare parts replaced during the service.

Do you use genuine spare parts for all RO brands?

Yes, we strictly use authentic, original spare parts from authorized dealers for all brands including Kent, Aquaguard, Pureit, etc.

How often should I service my RO water purifier?

It is highly recommended to service your RO purifier at least once every 6 months and replace the filters annually for optimal performance and water safety.

What areas do you cover for RO services?

We currently provide doorstep RO services across the entire Delhi NCR region, including Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, and Faridabad.
